latest_release.name: v1.3
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Change duplicate keybind by @orbitalmartian8 in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/529
* Fixed MacOS Packages (brew) and formatting for Commands by @Bisher-Almasri in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/537
* Remove rpath patch in AppImage by @Samueru-sama in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/530
* MSVC fixes by @cxong in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/544
* Add code signing to DMG creation step by @GlacieAwn in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/570
* Fix typo in Theming section of README by @GlacieAwn in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/576
* Add support for slower V8 initialization without the snapshot blob by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/587
* Fix wrong font license copyrights by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/588
* Add path pre-verification before saving by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/589
* Add SDL hints to disable pixel rescaling on hi-dpi screens under Windows by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/590
* Fix broken reference to script module documentation by @Scout2012 in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/583
* Add invert scroll option by @vaguirre-mx in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/591
* Fix for ui::Splitter Widget bug by @KELO-R in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/593
* Update GitHub workflow with manual app codesigning for Silicon Mac by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/604
* Fix font alignment for the 'Add Text' tool by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/626
* reduce 'unknown windowevent' stdout spam by @ribbon-otter in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/625
* Fix the first-run UI scale to be estimated based on the real screen size by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/645
* Extend the symmetry commands options by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/644
* Allow removing hidden layers by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/643
* Fix sprite height reported by crash recovery by @killerdevildog in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/649
* Sort file type dropdown alphabetically by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/653
* Add keyboard shortcut to toggle Tiled Mode by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/652
* Increase max brush size limit to 256px by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/651
* Allow typing/pasting a path in the file selector's location bar by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/654
* Flatten layer groups when loading .ase files by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/661
* Backport bugfixes from Besprited clang-tidy cleanup pass by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/666
* Fix security issues: zip-slip, shell injection, codec memory safety, script sandbox escapes by @Nidrax in https://github.com/LibreSprite/LibreSprite/pull/668
